fields.description: Save-validity stamp: 31-char ROM identifier + NUL plus one trailing NUL. FUN_08004efc loads exactly 0x21 bytes from SRAM 0x0E000000 and compares bytes 0x00..0x1F against the ROM string behind _DAT_08004f14; a mismatch triggers the first-boot init path in FUN_08004d54.
fields.evidence: FUN_08004efc does func_0x08061d0c(0xe000000, acStack_28, 0x21) then memcmp-style loop vs _DAT_08004f14; FUN_08004d54 branches on its result and rewrites the 0x21-byte stamp via func_0x08061d70(uVar3, 0xe000000, 0x21). Baseline bytes 0x00..0x20 match exactly.
fields.name: save_magic

fields.description: Three unwritten 0xFF bytes between the 0x21-byte magic and the 4-aligned payload at 0x24. Never read by FUN_08004efc (reads 0x00..0x20) and never written by the FUN_08004d54 init path (payload writes start at 0x24); baseline holds 0xFF 0xFF 0xFF.
fields.evidence: FUN_08004efc reads SRAM 0x0E000000+0x00..0x20 (0x21 bytes) and FUN_08004d54 persists only the magic plus the 4-byte/8-byte payloads at file offsets 0x24..0x2F, leaving 0x21..0x23 untouched (0xFF in samples/baseline.sav).
fields.name: magic_gap_pad

fields.description: Active file/group selector (values 0..2). RAM save-struct byte 0 is used as a group base ((uint)*pbVar2 * 3) when scanning the slot table in both the FUN_08004d54 load path and the FUN_08004f98 slot-search routine; both scan loops are bounded to 3 entries.
fields.evidence: FUN_08004d54 load path indexes pbVar7[(uint)*pbVar2 * 3] with a <3 scan loop after func_0x08061d0c(uRam08004ee8, pbVar2, 4); FUN_08004f98 repeats the (uint)*pbVar2 * 3 + 4 pattern. File offset 0x24 = persisted struct head: contiguous 12-zero-byte payload at 0x24..0x2F, 4-aligned, loaded head-first (4B then 8B).
fields.name: active_file_slot

fields.description: Three slot-scoped state bytes of the persisted struct head (RAM bytes 1..3). Zeroed alongside the selector by the FUN_08004d54 first-boot init path and used by FUN_08004f98 as slot-valued compare/store bytes (pbVar2[_DAT_0800503c] compared against a 0..2 slot, pbVar2[_DAT_08005040] assigned the resolved 0..2 slot). Baseline is 0x00 0x00 0x00.
fields.evidence: FUN_08004d54 init zeroes *pbVar2 plus indexed bytes pbVar2[_DAT_08004db0] / pbVar2[_DAT_08004db4] / pbVar2[_DAT_08004db4 - 1] before persisting the 4-byte head via func_0x08061d70/func_0x08061de0; FUN_08004f98 compares pbVar2[_DAT_0800503c] and stores pbVar2[_DAT_08005040].
fields.name: file_select_aux

fields.description: Normalized file-valid flag for the active slot: 1 when the slot holds a file marker, else 0. Boot/menu setup (FUN_080052d94) stores (FUN_08004f98(0) ? 1 : 0) into save-struct byte 4, the first byte of the persisted 8-byte slot table.
fields.evidence: FUN_080052d94 calls FUN_08004f98(0) then executes *(char *)(iVar1 + 5) = cVar2 with *(iVar1 + 4) = (cVar2 ? 1 : 0); iVar1 carries the same save-struct layout (offsets +4/+5) persisted by FUN_08004d54 via func_0x08061d0c(uRam08004eec, pbVar2 + 4, 8). Baseline value 0x00.
fields.name: file_valid_flag

fields.description: Raw result of the slot probe for file 0 stored into save-struct byte 5. Same FUN_080052d94 sequence as file_valid_flag but keeps the un-normalized FUN_08004f98(0) return value.
fields.evidence: FUN_080052d94 stores cVar2 = FUN_08004f98(0) directly into *(char *)(iVar1 + 5), i.e. persisted slot-table byte 1 (file offset 0x29) loaded/saved by the FUN_08004d54 8-byte payload transfer. Baseline value 0x00.
fields.name: file_probe_result

fields.description: Remaining six bytes of the persisted 8-byte slot table (RAM bytes 6..11): per-group marker bytes and the entries of file groups 1-2. Scanned (never individually named) by the (uint)*pbVar2 * 3 + index marker loops in the FUN_08004d54 load path and FUN_08004f98; untouched by FUN_080052d94, hence still first-boot zeros in the baseline.
fields.evidence: FUN_08004d54 load loop scans pbVar7[(uint)*pbVar2 * 3 + i] (<3 entries) and FUN_08004f98 scans pbVar2[(uint)*pbVar2 * 3 + 4 + uVar3]; both cover this tail range of the 8 bytes moved by func_0x08061d0c(uRam08004eec, pbVar2 + 4, 8). Baseline is six 0x00 bytes.
fields.name: slot_table_tail

magic_signatures.description: ASCII 'GENOM BY PRODUCTION-IG Ver 1.22' + NUL + trailing NUL; full 0x21-byte region checked by FUN_08004efc
